title: Etch chamber pressure excursion checks
symptom: chamber pressure pressure drift elevated pressure
steps: Confirm the event timestamp and lot. Compare the pressure trend with the qualified recipe window. Review recent chamber clean and maintenance notes. Escalate persistent drift to the equipment owner; do not adjust controls outside the approved procedure.

title: CVD heater temperature review
symptom: heater temperature thermal excursion high temperature
steps: Verify the sensor reading against the secondary monitor. Check the recent temperature trend and recipe phase. Place the affected lot on engineering review hold when the excursion is critical. Contact the equipment owner before any recovery action.

title: Lithography overlay shift investigation
symptom: overlay error overlay shift alignment drift
steps: Review overlay measurements from the current lot and the preceding monitor wafer. Check alignment-mark quality and recent recipe changes. Compare with the qualified baseline. Route persistent shifts to lithography engineering for disposition.

title: CMP slurry flow verification
symptom: slurry flow low high flow rate
steps: Check the flow sensor trend and confirm the active recipe. Review recent slurry delivery maintenance. Compare against the qualified operating window and request equipment-owner review when the reading remains outside limits.

title: Metrology defect-rate excursion review
steps: Confirm the sample size and inspection recipe. Compare defect signatures with the prior control wafer. Check for a metrology configuration change. Escalate a repeated increase for engineering review before disposition.
